title: Boullard Musique
description: Boullard Musique (boullard.ch) is one of Switzerland's premier specialty retailers of musical instruments and audio gear, founded in Morges in 1979. The company operates a dedicated physical showroom alongside an extensive e-commerce platform offering acoustic instruments, electronic gear, and accessories. Beyond retail, they provide comprehensive instrument rentals, maintenance, and expert repair services through their on-site workshops.
